message: Vector Rebel 3.2.81: Historical C-shift test for November 15-16, 2026, using existing read-only Item Log verification.
releaseNotes: C-shift Master and User crew boards can review the last completed C tour, including Sunday Nov 15 and Monday Nov 16. Master can confirm historical duty, map current scoped Responsible Party PPE to past tour for preliminary inventory, and perform manual read-only Item Log checks on one outstanding item per historically confirmed-working person. Only dates in the selected tour qualify as verified. Historical work is not automatically scanned and does not submit PPE inspections; dedicated monitoring remains current-tour-only. No Vector administrator access or CrewSense writes required.
